_approach: RYM's krushclub definition explicitly allows a 'four-on-the-floor rhythm' as an alternative to the Jersey Club base (crediting the genre's classic-EDM/house side). This groove is the house-leaning branch: plain four-on-the-floor kick, offbeat open hat (house/EDM vocabulary, not Jersey), and a bitcrushed cowbell/perc loop carrying the krush texture on top — proof the fusion works even without the 5-kick shape, the way it does in krushclub's more house-adjacent tracks.
